observations.finding: 10/50 pathways significant at q<0.05; strongest effects: PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS down (SMD -1.22, q=0.0), HEHE_METABOLISM down (SMD -0.86, q=0.0003), DNA_REPAIR up (SMD 0.86, q=0.0015), FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM down (SMD -0.82, q=0.0015), MYC_TARGETS_V2 up (SMD 0.78, q=0.010).
23/49 features significant at q<0.05; CDKN2A lower (delta -0.53, q=0.0005), chr6p lower (-0.52), chr20q higher (+0.51), chr9p lower (-0.51), PTEN lower (-0.49, q=0.0008).

6/107 significant; PTEN loss enriched (27.5% vs 0%, OR 49.5, q=0.0005), chr6p loss (25% vs 1.6%, OR 20.7, q=0.003), CDKN2A loss (42.5% vs 12.7%, OR 5.1, q=0.007), chr10q loss (17.5% vs 0%, q=0.007), chr20q gain (30% vs 6.3%, OR 6.3, q=0.013).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Coherent, strong RNA and CNV signals with large effect sizes and low q-values. CNV pattern (CDKN2A/PTEN/chr9p loss, chr20q gain) is internally consistent with a distinct copy-number profile.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0001 shows a coherent molecular profile characterized by CDKN2A/PTEN loss and chr20q gain with accompanying transcriptional shifts; this is affirmative biological evidence for a distinct set identity.
limitations: WXS not available in this round; no mutation-level corroboration.
Pathway and CNV findings are relative to the rest of the partition.

observations.finding: 27/50 pathways significant at q<0.05; ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION down (SMD -0.85, q=0.0006), HEHE_METABOLISM up (SMD 0.83, q=0.0006), IL6_JAK_STAT3 down (SMD -0.81, q=0.0006), MYC_TARGETS_V2 down (SMD -0.88, q=0.0014), TGF_BETA up (SMD 0.70, q=0.0023).
20/49 significant at q<0.05; chr12p lower (delta -0.66, q=9.4e-06), chr12q lower (-0.59), chr20q lower (-0.58), VHL lower (-0.55, q=0.0002), PBRM1 lower (-0.54, q=0.0002).
2/107 significant; chr14q loss depleted (12.1% vs 54.3%, OR 0.12, q=0.0004), CDKN2A loss depleted (6.1% vs 32.9%, OR 0.13, q=0.022).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Strong RNA signal (27 significant pathways) and strong CNV continuous signal with large negative effects on chr12p/12q, VHL, PBRM1. Gain/loss enrichment is sparse but directionally coherent (depletion of chr14q and CDKN2A loss).
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0002 shows a coherent molecular profile with broad transcriptional differences and a distinct copy-number pattern (chr12p/12q lower, VHL/PBRM1 lower, chr14q-loss depleted); affirmative biological evidence for a distinct set identity.
limitations: WXS not available in this round; no mutation-level corroboration.
Gain/loss enrichment limited to 2 significant features.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Weaker but directionally coherent RNA signal (interferon up, myogenesis/WNT down) and modest CNV continuous signal (PTEN/chr6p/chr2p/chr10q higher). Gain/loss enrichment is non-significant with directionally consistent trends.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0003 shows a weaker but coherent molecular profile with interferon-up transcriptional features and a modest copy-number pattern; evidence is present but less pronounced than C0001/C0002.
limitations: WXS not available in this round.
Fewer significant RNA pathways and no significant gain/loss features; effect sizes moderate.

actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, strong RNA and CNV identity evidence (CDKN2A/PTEN loss, chr20q gain), no set-level technical confounders, and cross-modal structure that is modest but stable (ARI 0.75) with positive RNA/WSI support and shallow but present boundaries to C0002/C0003. No material unresolved question requires an available request, so retain for downstream validation.

C0002 shows coherent biological identity with strong RNA (27 pathways) and CNV (chr12p/12q, VHL/PBRM1 lower) signals, no set-level technical confounders, and consistent cross-modal membership support (median 3.0) with positive boundaries to C0001/C0003. Lower resample stability is a limitation but not a material unresolved question requiring an available request.

C0003 has weaker but directionally coherent biological evidence (interferon-up, modest CNV) and weakly positive cross-modal structure, but its membership is significantly associated with tissue source site and CT manufacturer, providing a plausible technical competing explanation. No available evidence request remains to resolve this, so retain as a discovery-stage candidate with explicit uncertainty for downstream validation.
